map.销售成本 / 平均存货 使用指南: Cost of Sales / Average Inventory User Guide
map.输入营业成本与平均存货余额，计算存货周转率与周转天数，衡量库存变现速度，适用于仓: Enter the cost of sales and average inventory balance to compute inventory turnover and turnover days, measuring how fast inventory converts to cash; suitable for warehousing management, supply chain efficiency and dead stock diagnosis.
map.存货周转率 = 销售成本/平均存货: Inventory turnover = cost of sales / average inventory
map.周转率 = 营业成本 / 平均存货。: Turnover ratio = cost of sales / average inventory.
map.衡量一年内存货被卖出并补充的次数，反映运营效率。: Measures how many times inventory is sold and replenished within a year, reflecting operating efficiency.
map.零售、制造等行业用周转率评估采购与销售节奏是否匹配。: Retail, manufacturing and other industries use turnover to assess whether purchasing and sales rhythms match.
map.对比行业，发现滞销品或备货过量问题。: Compare with the industry to spot slow-moving items or overstocking.
map.：某公司年度销售成本 3600 万元，期初存货 250 万元、期末 350 万元: : A company has annual cost of sales of 36,000,000 CNY, opening inventory of 2,500,000 CNY and closing inventory of 3,500,000 CNY; average inventory = 3,000,000 CNY, inventory turnover = 3600/300 = 12 times per year, roughly one turn every 30 days.
map.由净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本变动求 OCF: OCF from net profit, depreciation and amortization, and working capital changes
map.存货周转率和存货天数有什么关系？: What is the relationship between inventory turnover and inventory days?
map.两者互为倒数（天数=365÷周转率）；高周转率对应短天数，都衡量存货运营效率，只: The two are reciprocals (days = 365 / turnover); a high turnover corresponds to fewer days. Both measure inventory operating efficiency, just from different angles.
map.高周转率一定好吗？: Is a high turnover always good?
map.高周转通常意味着畅销、资金高效，但也可能备货不足错失销售；生鲜等行业天然高周转，: High turnover usually means strong sales and efficient capital use, but it may also mean understocking and lost sales; fresh food and similar industries are naturally high-turnover while durables are lower, so compare within the same industry.
